claims.claim: You can apply for a needs assessment by phone.
claims.quote: Contact social services at your local council and ask for a needs assessment. You can call them or do it online.
claims.note: The text says you can call your council's social services to ask for a needs assessment.

claims.claim: You can apply for or have the needs assessment in person.
claims.quote: The needs assessment can happen: face-to-face
claims.note: The text says the assessment itself can take place face-to-face, though it does not describe applying in person.
